_comment: ONLY add config to this file if it is ACCEPTANCE TEST related and you wish to override the config from the website
_ConnectionStrings_comment: Its own database, deliberately. Every host and test suite used to point at the same LocalDB
'LondonFhirService', so running the suites concurrently - which is what 'dotnet test' on the
solution does - had them creating, seeding and deleting each other's rows, producing failures
that vanished on re-run in isolation. Each suite migrates its own database at startup via
Database.Migrate(), so no extra provisioning step is needed.
_LdsConfigurations_comment: Placeholders, present only so the host can start. Program.AddProviders throws unless
LdsConfigurations:BaseUrl parses as an absolute URI, and the shipped appsettings.json
leaves it as the override_this_in_your_... marker - so without this section every test in
this project failed in the collection fixture's constructor, before any test body ran.
Nothing here is dialled: TestWebApplicationFactory removes the real
IFhirAbstractionProvider and IStu3FhirBroker registrations and substitutes mocks, so the
LDS provider is never constructed against these values. The host is the thing under test
